idea-plugin.name: Spreadsheet Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Edit CSV/TSV files in a real table — add and delete rows and columns, edit cells — and view XLSX workbooks, without leaving the IDE.

Respects how your files open. The table view is an extra tab next to the regular text editor, never a forced replacement. Your CSV files keep opening exactly as before; the table is there when you want it.

The XLSX viewer parses workbooks off the UI thread with a purpose-built lightweight reader (no heavyweight office libraries bundled), so opening a spreadsheet never freezes the IDE.

Free. No license nags, no tracking, no network access.
